ground.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production candidate bitmap for a dark fantasy 2D isometric game, NOT concept panorama. Exactly three reference images: Image 1 HQ18 Q3 v01 ONLY material-world pale elven carved stone architecture, pointed arches, slate blue roofs, cool stone paving and localized amber fires; exclude its abyss, roots, purple portal, people and troops. Image 2 HQ03 Q1 v03 ONLY dark green circular forest, dense red flowers, intact crystal fallen star, straight blue beam, active blue Tarn. Image 3 HQ03 Q2 v03 ONLY Ailalore's jagged crystal appearance, large relative scale and LIGHT BLUE color; exclude Adam, scythe, strike, green clouds and cracked/collapsed Tarn. Follow approved direction: crisp painterly pixel-art-compatible fantasy material detail, readable at game scale, restrained noise, cold gray-blue stone, pale weathered carved stone, dark green vegetation, crimson red flowers, light blue crystal and sparse amber light. No characters, UI, text, labels, numbers, mannequins, ruler, logos, watermark, frames or background illustration. Do not draw full city/garden scenes. No new lore. Square image. Create a flat TOP-DOWN material texture atlas to be mapped onto isometric ground by the game. Exactly four separate equal square cells arranged in a strict 2x2 grid, no visible grid lines. Each motif centered inside its own quadrant, with ample empty margins/gutters; motifs never cross cell boundaries. Consistent scale and lighting, upper-left cool soft key. Each quadrant filled edge-to-edge with opaque paving texture, no gutters needed for this material-only atlas: top left regular cool gray-blue worn elven paving; top right a restrained fine carved vegetal seam in matching paving; bottom left darker worn paving with a few subtle tiny chips; bottom right calm clean plaza paving. Similar brightness across cells, low contrast seams, no bright medallions, rubble piles, plants, flowers, shadows, perspective, diamond silhouette, buildings, borders or light sources. Orthographic overhead texture, never pre-project as isometric. Intended destination 1024x1024, 512 square cells; prioritize material continuity and calm tiled surface.
